ai.title: Raise large file token limit to 16k
ai.summary: LARGE_FILE_TOKEN_LIMIT constant increased from 11,000 to 16,000 in backend/src/process-file-block.ts. This adjustment allows the handleLargeFile function to process bigger files before triggering overflow logic. Scope limited to backend file processing logic.

eli5.text: The system that checks how big a file can be before it starts breaking it into smaller pieces now waits until files are bigger before switching modes. Files up to a slightly larger size will be processed in one pass instead of being split. The backend file-processing logic is the only thing affected, and the new threshold is already in place today.

ai.title: Add extended thinking support to Claude backend
ai.summary: Added `Thinking` type and `thinking` option to `promptClaude` functions in `backend/src/claude.ts`, matching Anthropic's API. Updated `planComplexChange` in `backend/src/planning.ts` to use `promptClaude` with Sonnet and enabled thinking (4k/10k budget) instead of OpenAI o3-mini. Temperature forced to 1 when thinking enabled.

eli5.text: When the system needs to work through a complicated request, like planning a big code change, it can now use an extended-thinking mode that gives the assistant more time and space to reason through multiple steps before responding, similar to how a person might pause to think carefully before answering a tough question. This kicks in automatically whenever the system uses a specific helper function (think of it as a specialized assistant) behind the scenes, so anyone relying on that part of the service will get slightly slower but more thorough planning without any action needed on their end.

ai.title: Increase default maxtokens for Claude
ai.summary: Default `max_tokens` for Anthropic streaming requests raised from 8192 to 20,000 in `backend/src/claude.ts`. Change applies to `promptClaudeStreamWithoutRetry` when no explicit token limit is provided. Scope limited to backend Claude integration. Internal configuration adjustment.

eli5.text: When you ask the assistant to generate a long response and don't set a limit yourself, the system now allows it to write up to 20,000 words instead of stopping at roughly 8,000. This only affects the internal backend service that talks to the assistant; if you never hit a cutoff, you probably won't notice anything different. The change is already live today.

ai.title: Fix long pause before planning in process-stream
ai.summary: Changed `continue` to `break` in `processStreamWithTags` loop within `backend/src/process-stream.ts`. This stops processing chunks immediately after `streamCompleted` flag is set, preventing unnecessary iteration over remaining stream data. Fixes a performance issue causing long pauses before planning steps begin.

eli5.text: When you run a task that generates a long reply piece by piece, the system used to keep going through the rest of the reply data even after it already had enough to start planning your next step, which created a noticeable delay before it moved on. This fix stops it from reading those extra bits right away, so the pause you felt is gone. You just see the assistant proceed to the next step sooner instead of waiting.
